'''''Helleborus cyclophyllus''''' is a flowering perennial plant in the family [[Ranunculaceae]].<ref name=WFoL>{{cite web|url= http://www.worldfloraonline.org/taxon/wfo-0000719141|title= Helleborus cyclophyllus Boiss.|author=<!--Not stated-->|date=n.d.|website=World Flora Online|publisher=The World Flora Online Consortium|access-date= September 19, 2020}}</ref> It is native to [[Albania]], [[Bulgaria]], [[Greece]], and [[Yugoslavia]].<ref name=KewPOWO/> It is similar in appearance to other [[hellebore]]s found in the [[Balkans|Balkan region]]. It is acaulescent, meaning it lacks a stem with leaves, instead sending up a leafless flower stalk. The green leaves are palmate and basal, spreading at the ground. The flowers are green to yellow-green and 2 to 3 inches in diameter.
